declarations.name: currentChenUpsilon9PrefixPrimeFibre_divisor_card
declarations.signature:
theorem currentChenUpsilon9PrefixPrimeFibre_divisor_card (N a d : ℕ) :
    ((currentChenUpsilon9PrefixPrimeFibre N a).filter
      (fun q => d ∣ N - a * q)).card = primesInAPBelow N a d N
declarations.premises_and_assessment: All N,a,d. Under a*q<=N, natural subtraction has d | N-a*q iff a*q congruent N mod d, including a*q=N and receiver zero.

declarations.name: currentChenUpsilon9_prefix_sum_upperDivisorSum
declarations.signature:
theorem currentChenUpsilon9_prefix_sum_upperDivisorSum
    (N a cap : ℕ) (z L : ℝ) :
    (∑ q ∈ currentChenUpsilon9PrefixPrimeFibre N a,
      supportedDivisorSum (actualSmallRosserSupport N cap z)
        (actualSmallRosserPlus N cap z L) (N - a * q)) =
      ∑ d ∈ actualSmallRosserSupport N cap z,
        actualSmallRosserPlus N cap z L d * (primesInAPBelow N a d N : ℝ)
declarations.premises_and_assessment: All N,a,cap,z,L. No sign, sieve, primitive residue or asymptotic premise is used for this finite identity.

declarations.name: currentChenUpsilon9_switchedPrimeFibre_card_le_upperDivisorSum_add_cap
declarations.signature:
theorem currentChenUpsilon9_switchedPrimeFibre_card_le_upperDivisorSum_add_cap
    (N a cap : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (z L : ℝ) (hL : 1 < L) (hzL : z ≤ L) :
    ((currentChenUpsilon9SwitchedPrimeFibre N a).card : ℝ) ≤
      (∑ q ∈ currentChenUpsilon9PrefixPrimeFibre N a,
        supportedDivisorSum (actualSmallRosserSupport N cap z)
          (actualSmallRosserPlus N cap z L) (N - a * q)) + (Nat.ceil z : ℝ)

Small q maps injectively to N-a*q<ceil(z) because both original products are strictly below N and a>0. Expansion to additional q, including receiver zero, uses full-sum nonnegativity only.

declarations.name: currentChenUpsilon9_product_sum_upperDivisorSum
declarations.signature:
theorem currentChenUpsilon9_product_sum_upperDivisorSum
    (N cap : ℕ) (z L : ℝ) :
    (∑ a ∈ currentChenUpsilon9PrefixProducts N,
      ∑ q ∈ currentChenUpsilon9PrefixPrimeFibre N a,
        supportedDivisorSum (actualSmallRosserSupport N cap z)
          (actualSmallRosserPlus N cap z L) (N - a * q)) =
      ∑ d ∈ actualSmallRosserSupport N cap z,
        actualSmallRosserPlus N cap z L d * currentChenUpsilon9PrefixAPCount N d
declarations.premises_and_assessment: Exact finite reordering over the actual product image and exact closed AP count. No tuple/factorization factorial or new zero-one coefficient is introduced.

declarations.name: currentChenUpsilon9_upper_sum_eq_active
declarations.signature:
private theorem currentChenUpsilon9_upper_sum_eq_active
    (B : ℝ) (N cap : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (G : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ d ∈ actualSmallRosserSupport N cap z,
      actualSmallRosserPlus N cap z ((panModulusCutoff N B + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) d * G d) =
      ∑ d ∈ currentChenUpsilon9PanActive B N cap z,
        actualSmallRosserPlus N cap z ((panModulusCutoff N B + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) d * G d
declarations.premises_and_assessment: Arbitrary B,N,cap,z,G. Actual upper Rosser level Q+1 gives d<Q+1 whenever weight nonzero, so terms with d>Q vanish identically. No termwise inequality or sign assumption is used.

declarations.name: currentChenUpsilon9_upper_AP_sum_eq_main_errors
declarations.signature:
theorem currentChenUpsilon9_upper_AP_sum_eq_main_errors
    (B : ℝ) {N : ℕ} (hN : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N) (cap : ℕ) (z : ℝ) :
    (∑ d ∈ actualSmallRosserSupport N cap z,
      actualSmallRosserPlus N cap z ((panModulusCutoff N B + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) d *
        currentChenUpsilon9PrefixAPCount N d) =
      currentChenUpsilon9LiMainMass N * currentChenUpsilon9SwitchedUpperDensity B N cap z -
        currentChenUpsilon9CoprimeGateError N cap z ((panModulusCutoff N B + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
          (currentChenUpsilon9PanActive B N cap z) +
        currentChenUpsilon9PanRosserError B N cap z
declarations.semantic_scope: Exact main minus gate plus signed Pan
declarations.premises_and_assessment: N>=1. Every actual support modulus is coprime to N, paying the Pan decomposition primitive-target condition. The signed full noncoprime li defect is kept and its zero-weight inactive moduli are removed by exact identity. Scalar mass factors out of exactly the displayed density.

declarations.name: currentChenUpsilon9_le_upper_density_main_add_errors
declarations.signature:
theorem currentChenUpsilon9_le_upper_density_main_add_errors
    (B : ℝ) {N : ℕ} (hN : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N) (cap : ℕ) (z : ℝ)
    (hL : 1 < ((panModulusCutoff N B + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
    (hzL : z ≤ ((panModulusCutoff N B + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) :
    currentChenUpsilon9 N ≤
      currentChenUpsilon9LiMainMass N * currentChenUpsilon9SwitchedUpperDensity B N cap z -
        currentChenUpsilon9CoprimeGateError N cap z ((panModulusCutoff N B + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
          (currentChenUpsilon9PanActive B N cap z) +
        currentChenUpsilon9PanRosserError B N cap z +
        ((currentChenUpsilon9PrefixProducts N).card : ℝ) * (Nat.ceil z : ℝ) +
        ((currentChenUpsilon9UnitFibres N).card : ℝ)
declarations.premises_and_assessment: N>=1,1<Q+1,z<=Q+1. Actual switched-prime plus unit-fibre source inequality and per-positive-multiplier cap supply exactly main - signed gate + signed Pan + cardinality*ceil(z) + actual unit count.

declarations.name: currentChenUpsilon9_small_prime_cost_le_power
declarations.signature:
theorem currentChenUpsilon9_small_prime_cost_le_power {N : ℕ} (hN : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N) :
    ((currentChenUpsilon9PrefixProducts N).card : ℝ) *
      (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ)) : ℝ) ≤
        4 * (N : ℝ) ^ (409 / 500 : ℝ)
declarations.premises_and_assessment: N>=1. Original product image is a subset of range ceil(N^(309/500)); both ceiling factors are at most twice their powers, so cost <=4*N^(309/500+1/5)=4*N^(409/500). No prime counting estimate or unproved harmonic approximation is used.
